title: Special Limits and Included Coverages of the RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
Within the Coverage C limit of a RentGuard Renters Policy, certain classes of property are capped at special limits and certain coverages are included up to a stated amount. The schedule below states each of them for all six HO-4 tiers. Amounts are in USD; a figure of 0 means the coverage is not included on that tier.

## Property away from the rental premises

| Tier | Coverage C available away from the rental premises (percent of Coverage C) |
|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 20 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 20 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 100 |

## Special limits of liability

| Tier | Theft of jewelry, watches and furs | Laptops, phones, tablets and cameras (per occurrence) | Bicycles and e-bikes (per occurrence) | Money and bank notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 1000 | 1500 | 500 | 200 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 1500 | 2500 | 1000 | 200 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 1500 | 2500 | 1000 | 200 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 2500 | 5000 | 1500 | 500 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 2500 | 5000 | 2500 | 500 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 5000 | 10000 | 5000 | 500 |

## Included coverages

| Tier | Landlord's furnishings in the unit | Water backup and sump discharge (contents) | Identity fraud expense | Refrigerated food spoilage after a power outage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 0 | 0 | 0 | 250 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 2500 | 5000 | 0 | 500 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 2500 | 5000 | 15000 | 500 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 5000 | 10000 | 25000 | 500 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 5000 | 10000 | 25000 | 1000 |

## Notes on the schedule

- A 0 in the included-coverages table means the tier does not cover that item: HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential carry no landlord's-furnishings or water backup coverage, and identity fraud expense begins at HO-4 Premier.
- Off-premises coverage is a share of the policy's own Coverage C limit. As a hypothetical example, a RentGuard HO-4 Premier policy with a Coverage C limit of 50000 covers property away from the rental premises up to 20 percent of 50000, which is 10000; the same limit on HO-4 Signature makes the whole 50000 available away from the premises.
